name: Swarmwyrm
theme: a dragon assembled out of a locust plague — the swarm hit critical density, learned a shape, and decided to keep it
prompt: A long serpentine dragon that is obviously not one animal: its coiled body is packed from thousands of interlocked beetle wing-cases and locust bodies, every scale visibly an individual insect, so the whole outline crawls and frays. Its head is a wedge of interlocking carapace with a pair of huge scissoring mandibles standing in for jaws, crowned by two swept horns and a cluster of small compound eyes. Four stacked gossamer wings fan out from mid-body, and a thin haze of stragglers trails behind the tail, never quite catching up to the shape.
palette: deep wine-red and blackberry-violet carapace with a dark beetle-green oil sheen across the wing-cases, midnight indigo between segments, a thin cold honey-gold glimmer through the wing membranes — iridescent but dark, never candy-bright
